title: सूरज डूबते ही गायब हो जाती है परछाई
topic: एक अनोखा जादुई रोमांच जहाँ परछाइयों का गायब होना एक राज खोलता है
description: सोचिए क्या हो अगर सूरज ढलते ही आपकी परछाई आपका साथ छोड़ दे? नन्हे चिंटू की परछाई के गायब होने और एक अजीब दुनिया के राज की यह मज़ेदार और सीख भरी कहानी। #KahaniPatang #KidsStories #MagicStory #HindiKahani #BedtimeStories
thumb_visual: English: extreme close-up of a 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu face with clear shock, wide eyes, cinematic lighting

characters.Chintu: English character sheet: age 7, round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, Indian look

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: ज़रा सोचिए... आप धूप में खड़े हैं, पर आपकी परछाई ज़मीन पर है ही नहीं!
scenes.style: warm, gentle storyteller, raising eyebrows in curiosity
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, standing in a sunny courtyard in an Indian village, looking down at the ground with utter shock, medium shot, bright daylight.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: असंभव लगता है ना? पर आज जो नन्हे चिंटू के साथ हुआ, उसने सबको हैरान कर दिया।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, looking around his empty backyard anxiously, afternoon lighting, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: शाम ढल रही थी और चिंटू अपने घर के आँगन में खेल रहा था।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, playing with a small wooden ball in a traditional Indian courtyard, golden hour lighting, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: अचानक उसकी नज़र अपनी परछाई पर पड़ी... जो वहाँ थी ही नहीं!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, staring blankly at the feet area where no shadow is cast, dramatic evening light, close-up shot.

scenes.speaker: C
scenes.text: अरे मेरी परछाई कहाँ गई? क्या कोई उसे चुरा कर ले गया?
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, scratching his head in confusion in the courtyard, sunset lighting, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: आप होते तो क्या करते? क्या आप अपनी परछाई को ढूँढने निकलते?
scenes.style: direct question to the audience, engaging
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, looking straight ahead as if thinking hard, warm evening glow, portrait shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: चिंटू डरा नहीं, बल्कि उसने परछाई के पीछे जाने का फैसला किया।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, walking towards a dimly lit corner of the house with a determined expression, dusk, wide shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: घर के पीछे पुराने बरगद के पेड़ के पास एक हल्की सी नीली रोशनी चमक रही थी।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, peering cautiously behind a massive banyan tree emitting faint blue light, night approaching, medium shot.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: जैसे ही चिंटू पास पहुँचा, एक बहुत ही अजीब बात हुई।
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, stepping closer to glowing roots of the banyan tree, magical blue glow lighting his face, close-up.

scenes.speaker: N
scenes.text: पेड़ के तने पर उसकी परछाई दीवारों पर नाचती हुई दिखाई दी!
scenes.visual: English: 7-year-old Indian boy Chintu with round cute face, big curious black eyes, short messy black hair, average build, wearing a bright yellow t-shirt and blue shorts, pointing excitedly at a moving shadow projected on the banyan tree trunk, magical lighting, wide shot.
